description.value: Aureliana is a casual American diner on West Hastings in downtown Vancouver, turning out hearty breakfasts, hand-formed burgers, and fresh-cut fries in a compact, approachable setting. The menu spans classic morning fare like pastrami hash and eggs benedict through to poutine, milkshakes, and draft beer, making it a capable refuelling stop. Online ordering is available, and catering can be arranged by phone or email.
